newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks jump 2.09 pct, local hunt bargains.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks jump 2.09 pct, local hunt bargains.

text.p: Thai stocks rallied 2.09 percent at 0419 GMT as local investors went on a buying spree to pick up cheaply priced, large capitalised stocks, brokers said.
"I think local investors are active in the market now. Foreigners are sidelined as they are still worried about the Thai economy," said Samart Rusmeerojwong of James Capel Asia.
The composite SET index rose 11.09 points to 541.71 before winding down to 539.42, or up 1.66 percent. On Friday the index closed at a new eight year-low.

Most of the key sectors advanced. The banking sector topped the active list in terms of value, rising 3.87 percent followed by the finance sector gaining 1.38 percent and the communication sector surging 3.23 percent.
